hints.title: Weight Bounded Property
hints.text: Edge weights are strictly between 1 and 26, which is small enough to track counts of all weights along tree paths.

hints.title: Path Weight Frequencies via LCA
hints.text: For query (u, v), the count of weight w on path u-v is cnt[u][w] + cnt[v][w] - 2 * cnt[lca][w].

hints.title: Optimal Retained Weight
hints.text: To minimize edge changes, pick the edge weight with the maximum frequency along the path, and subtract that maximum from the total path length.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.time: O((n + q) * log n + q * W)
complexity.notes: Binary lifting for LCA queries and constant 26-element prefix weight vectors.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Traversing each path linearly per query requires O(q * n), exceeding time limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n * 26) extra memory for root-to-node weight counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Binary lifting LCA with path frequency decomposition.
